scheme_name: The West Bengal Incentive Scheme: Capacity Utilisation
other_conditions: Applicable to all eligible tourism projects/units and expansion projects of existing units set up on or after 22 February 2021
Eligible hotel units that started commercial operation between 7 January 2015 and 31 December 2020 but could not apply earlier due to absence of a Bar in the hotel
Units may be in the private sector, co‑operative sector, joint sector, or companies/undertakings owned or managed by the State Government
Project must be covered by a detailed feasibility report/project prepared for the purpose
Project must have been approved and sanctioned by a Central Financial Institution, Commercial Banks or State Financial Institutions
Unit must hold a Registration Certificate, Date of Commencement Certificate and Eligibility Certificate issued by the West Bengal Tourism Development Corporation Limited
benefits_summary: Provides 50% financial assistance up to ₹7,50,000 per project.
